descriptionPlain: We are seeking a highly motivated AI Scientist specializing in Machine Learning to join our growing AI R&D team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing and deploying cutting-edge deep learning models to solve real-world temporal modeling challenges in manufacturing. We’re looking for a candidate with strong practical R&D experience, grounded in solid theoretical fundamentals, and deep expertise in AI disciplines. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms and techniques, a track record of impactful publications in top-tier conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, CVPR, or ICCV, and a solid background in computer science and engineering. Experience collaborating with software engineering teams to scale and productize ML solutions is a strong plus. This is a high-impact role that combines foundational research, system-level design, and hands-on implementation. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions that guide strategic decisions and deliver tangible business value.

Experience collaborating with software engineering teams to scale and productize ML solutions is a strong plus. lists.content:
• Design and implement Transformer-based architectures for time-series prediction and sequence modeling, across both univariate and multivariate data.
  • Drive the full machine learning lifecycle—from exploratory data analysis to model deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct rigorous benchmarking, ablation studies, and performance optimization to ensure robustness and efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, engineers, and product managers to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Partner with software engineers to scale and productize ML algorithms within manufacturing AI software products.
  • Contribute to Gauss Labs’ intellectual property portfolio through patents and high-impact technical publications.
  • Mentor junior team members and play an active role in shaping the team’s AI roadmap and long-term strategy.

• Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in deep learning, with a strong focus on sequence modeling and time-series forecasting.
  • In-depth expertise in Transformer architectures and their applications beyond natural language processing.
  • Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
  • Solid mathematical foundation in statistics, optimization, and signal processing.
  • Familiarity with hybrid modeling approaches that combine deep learning and traditional statistical methods.
  • Experience working with noisy, sparse, or irregularly sampled time-series data.
  • Strong publication track record in top-tier ML/AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).
  • Practical experience deploying ML models in production environments, with knowledge of MLOps best practices.
  • [Nice to have] Familiar with state-of-the-art neural networks architecture. Preferably had experience in innovation in new architecture such as transformer based models.

You will help the team understand customer and product needs, guide technical approaches, and deliver reliable solutions for manufacturing use cases. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will combine people management with technical judgment while partnering closely with Team Leads and cross-functional teams.
description: The Data Science Manager leads and develops a team working at the intersection of manufacturing, data science, and AI. You will help the team understand customer and product needs, guide technical approaches, and deliver reliable solutions for manufacturing use cases. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will combine people management with technical judgment while partnering closely with Team Leads and cross-functional teams.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop data scientists through regular 1:1s, feedback, coaching, and performance management.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and capability development for the team.
  • Set technical expectations and review data science, data engineering, and analytical work.
  • Help translate manufacturing and customer problems into technical plans, success criteria, and actionable analysis.
  • Partner with Team Leads to align priorities, ownership, capacity, dependencies, and risks.
  • Work with Product, AI/ML, Software Engineering, SRE, and customer-facing teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Improve team practices for technical review, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Surface team and delivery risks early and communicate them clearly to relevant stakeholders.

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of related experience in data science, applied machine learning, analytics, data engineering, or a related technical discipline, including substantial hands-on data science experience.
  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing technical professionals and supporting their career growth.
  • Strong technical judgment in data science, including problem framing, statistical analysis, evaluation design, and interpretation of results; able to review analytical and modeling approaches and guide trade-offs.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear plans and outcomes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across teams and functions.
  • Professional Korean and working English (confirm based on customer and team needs).

• Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, industrial AI, or manufacturing data.
  • Experience delivering data science or AI solutions in customer or production environments.
  • Familiarity with feature engineering, model evaluation, or manufacturing process analytics.
  • Experience building team practices, hiring plans, or technical career development paths.

descriptionPlain:
Gauss Labs is seeking a data scientist who is passionate about data analysis and has a strong coding skills. In this role, you will contribute to developing AI solutions that address real-world challenges in the manufacturing industry, as well as building analytical tools that enable deeper understanding of complex data.
Your responsibilities will include mining, interpreting, and analyzing customer data to uncover hidden opportunities and fully leverage its potential. You will also develop tailored data models and tools to address specific customer needs. To achieve this, you will closely work with our cross-functional teams and collaborate with our customers to understand their unique challenges and data characteristics.
This position offers a unique opportunity to work with real-world, real-time manufacturing data and contribute to cutting-edge AI products that make a tangible impact. Together with a team of passionate and talented Gaussians, you will help shape innovative solutions by identifying new product features derived from a deep understanding of customer data.
We are looking for individuals who are eager to grow into ambidextrous experts—those who can excel in both AI technology and domain expertise to drive innovation at the intersection of data and industry.

descriptionPlain: Gauss Labs is an industrial AI company on a mission to revolutionize manufacturing with AI, starting with the semiconductor sector. Panoptes is an AI-based process intelligence solution deployed in high-volume manufacturing fabs, helping customers improve yield, reduce costs, and accelerate production. Our software runs in our customers’ own managed environments. As our Site Reliability Engineer, you are the first responder for the platform layer that Panoptes runs on in production at the customer site, and you own its on-call rotation. You won’t control the cluster/node layer; your job is to diagnose what the platform needs, make the case to the customer’s infrastructure team, and keep the platform reliable within their constraints. You will also own monitoring and alerting for the platform layer, and build the automation and observability that reduce operational toil and speed up incident response.
description: Gauss Labs is an industrial AI company on a mission to revolutionize manufacturing with AI, starting with the semiconductor sector. Panoptes is an AI-based process intelligence solution deployed in high-volume manufacturing fabs, helping customers improve yield, reduce costs, and accelerate production. Our software runs in our customers’ own managed environments. As our Site Reliability Engineer, you are the first responder for the platform layer that Panoptes runs on in production at the customer site, and you own its on-call rotation. You won’t control the cluster/node layer; your job is to diagnose what the platform needs, make the case to the customer’s infrastructure team, and keep the platform reliable within their constraints. You will also own monitoring and alerting for the platform layer, and build the automation and observability that reduce operational toil and speed up incident response.

lists.content:
• Incident Response and On-call: Own first-response and the on-call rotation for the platform layer. Alerts are routed to the owning team and when an internal incident spans more than one team, this role coordinates the response in the incident channel.
  • Customer-environment operations and technical communication: Deploy and operate Panoptes at the application-namespace level in the customer-managed environment. The cluster, node, and Kubernetes layer is controlled by the customer’s infrastructure team: diagnose what the platform needs, make the technical case to that team, and operate within their setup, decisions, and constraints.
  • Internal cloud (AWS) environment: Own the platform layer end-to-end in our internal development environment — cluster health, resource management (CPU/memory/OOM), scheduling, autoscaling, and Kubernetes/EKS lifecycle.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: Build and maintain robust monitoring and alerting for the infrastructure and platform layer to proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact the platform.
  • Automation: Develop automation tools and scripts to streamline operations, reduce manual effort, and enable engineering teams to operate their own services safely.
  • Capacity Planning: Forecast resource needs, optimize resource utilization, and ensure the platform infrastructure can handle increasing workloads.
  • Deployment infrastructure: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment infrastructure for the platform.
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance platform reliability, performance, and efficiency.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of industry experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or in platform/infrastructure engineering
  • Experience operating workloads on a cluster controlled by another team, and communicating technical needs across that boundary
  • Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production (EKS preferred): cluster lifecycle, scheduling, autoscaling, resource management
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with observability and alerting tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ElasticSearch, Jaeger)
  • Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash)
  • Working knowledge of GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Working proficiency in English for internal documentation and technical coordination

• Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and workloads.
  • Knowledge of database technologies (MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience operating systems in an environment you didn’t fully control — a customer site, on-prem, an MSP, or another team’s cluster
  • Experience leading incidents from diagnosis through root cause
  • Exposure to manufacturing, semiconductor, or enterprise B2B customer environments

descriptionPlain: Gauss Labs builds Industrial AI for the world's leading manufacturers, applying state-of-the-art ML to large volumes of real production data. A core focus of this role is building our internal tabular foundation models — pretraining, fine-tuning, and serving them in large-scale production systems. As a Senior/Staff AI Engineer, you will turn ML research into robust, scalable production systems and own them across their full lifecycle. You'll work with AI Scientists, Software Engineers, and Program Managers across Palo Alto, CA, and Seoul, South Korea.
description: Gauss Labs builds Industrial AI for the world's leading manufacturers, applying state-of-the-art ML to large volumes of real production data. A core focus of this role is building our internal tabular foundation models — pretraining, fine-tuning, and serving them in large-scale production systems. As a Senior/Staff AI Engineer, you will turn ML research into robust, scalable production systems and own them across their full lifecycle. You'll work with AI Scientists, Software Engineers, and Program Managers across Palo Alto, CA, and Seoul, South Korea.

lists.content:
• Partner with AI Scientists to build and productionize our tabular foundation models — owning the pretraining, fine-tuning, serving, and monitoring infrastructure and scaling it from research prototype to large-scale production.
  • Build reliable, performant ML infrastructure across research, staging, and production: data, training, and inference pipelines, CI/CD, observability, and reproducible workflows, tuned for latency, throughput, and resource usage.
  • Design evaluation and monitoring that reflect how models are actually used, including handling real-world data challenges such as distribution shift and limited labels.
  • Set engineering standards, lead design and architecture reviews, and drive adoption of new modeling approaches, algorithms, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate ML into user-facing systems.
  • Define scope and roadmap for multi-team initiatives, drive cross-team and cross-functional alignment across AI Science, engineering, and product, and mentor senior engineers to raise the organization's technical bar.

• BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, plus 6+ years of full-time experience; or MS/PhD plus 4+ years of full-time experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Python with a solid grounding in algorithms and data structures, and deep proficiency with the Python data/ML stack (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch or TensorFlow) for end-to-end model development.
  • 3+ years building production-grade ML infrastructure — data pipelines, training/inference workflows, and deployment automation — with solid software engineering fundamentals (Git, testing, code review, CI/CD, and containerization/orchestration such as Docker and Kubernetes).
  • Track record of shipping ML systems with real attention to scalability, performance, and reliability.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: owning the roadmap for multi-quarter, multi-team efforts, driving cross-team and cross-functional alignment, and mentoring other engineers.

• BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, plus 8+ years of full-time experience; or MS/PhD plus 6+ years of full-time experience.
  • Experience pretraining, fine-tuning, and serving foundation models and transformers of any modality (tabular, timeseries, language, vision, etc.) at scale.
  • Experience optimizing training and inference for large-scale models, including distributed/parallel training (multi-GPU/multi-node).
  • Experience deploying ML in production across batch, real-time, or edge settings.
  • Experience with models under real-world data challenges — distribution shift, limited or noisy labels, or continual learning.
  • Development in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Productive with AI-assisted / agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot) and eager to push their limits — building workflows and agents that raise the team's velocity.

descriptionPlain:
As a Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in aligning our AI solutions with the unique needs of our manufacturing clients. Your primary responsibility will be to lead the development of state-of-the-art AI applications that tackle complex industry challenges, driving innovation and enhancing productivity.
We are seeking an experienced data scientist capable of extracting valuable insights from manufacturing data. Your tasks will include mining, interpreting, and analyzing customer data to discover hidden opportunities and fully leverage its potential. Also, your role will involve direct interaction with customers to grasp their challenges and to understand their unique data characteristics. By closely engaging with customers, you will develop tailored data models and tools to meet their specific needs. Additionally, you will collaborate with our cross-functional teams to conceive, design, and develop innovative AI products for manufacturing by identifying new product features based on the understanding of customer data.
Join a team of passionate innovators dedicated to revolutionizing the future of manufacturing. Take the lead in pioneering cutting-edge AI initiatives that directly impact real-world outcomes. Collaborate with a diverse and talented group of experts where your ideas will be highly valued, and your contributions will drive Gauss Labs towards becoming the global leader in industrial AI innovation.

• BS/MS in Engineering, Science, or a related field.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and customer-focused mindset.

• MS in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field.

descriptionBody:
As a Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in aligning our AI solutions with the unique needs of our manufacturing clients. Your primary responsibility will be to lead the development of state-of-the-art AI applications that tackle complex industry challenges, driving innovation and enhancing productivity.

We are seeking an experienced data scientist capable of extracting valuable insights from manufacturing data. Your tasks will include mining, interpreting, and analyzing customer data to discover hidden opportunities and fully leverage its potential. Also, your role will involve direct interaction with customers to grasp their challenges and to understand their unique data characteristics. By closely engaging with customers, you will develop tailored data models and tools to meet their specific needs. Additionally, you will collaborate with our cross-functional teams to conceive, design, and develop innovative AI products for manufacturing by identifying new product features based on the understanding of customer data.

Join a team of passionate innovators dedicated to revolutionizing the future of manufacturing. Take the lead in pioneering cutting-edge AI initiatives that directly impact real-world outcomes. Collaborate with a diverse and talented group of experts where your ideas will be highly valued, and your contributions will drive Gauss Labs towards becoming the global leader in industrial AI innovation.

lists.content:
• Own the design, implementation, release, and production operation of reliable, scalable software systems
  • Turn requirements from Product, customer engagement, and AI science partners into designs and delivery plans, and drive the resulting work to release
  • Lead delivery of changes that require work from other teams; agree on interfaces and dependencies, and resolve technical disagreements
  • Review designs and code, and write technical documentation that other engineers can implement from
  • Respond to production incidents in customer environments, diagnose root causes, and complete the follow-up work
  • Improve testing, CI/CD, and release checks to catch defects before deployment
  • Mentor engineers through design, debugging, and code review

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • 8+ years of professional software development, building scalable, reliable, high-performance systems
  • Experience owning a production system end-to-end through design, release, and operation
  • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and core CS principles (operating systems, concurrency, databases, networking)
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, C/C++, Go, or Rust
  • English writing and speaking skills, with the ability to produce technical documentation, clearly explain technical concepts, and lead technical discussions in English.

• Track record of setting long-term technical direction that other teams adopted
  • Experience leading architecture and delivery across teams, including interface contracts and system migrations
  • Experience identifying recurring reliability or delivery problems and leading fixes across teams
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers to lead designs independently
  • Experience with ML systems in production (for example, MLflow, Ray, Kubeflow)
  • Experience with event-streaming and data-processing systems (for example, Kafka, Flink, Spark)
  • Experience building services on large databases (for example, MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, including on-premises or air-gapped deployment
  • Experience in semiconductor manufacturing or industrial data
  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related field
